info.description: A visual thinking model available through an API and a chat interface. It takes text, images, and video and reasons in visual space, including with multimodal tools. Input tokens cost $0.60 per million and output tokens $3.00 per million; the comparison table labels those rates uncached. The page does not publish a calendar date, a cached-token price, a context length, a maximum output, or a request URL.

zh.description: 可通过 API 和聊天界面使用的视觉思考模型。它接收文本、图像和视频，并在视觉空间中推理，包括使用多模态工具。输入每百万 tokens 0.60 美元，输出 3.00 美元；对照表把这两项标为未缓存价格。页面没有给出日历日期、缓存价、上下文长度、最大输出或请求 URL。
